tldr: Morning batch (Sep 8) — compute is the story: Anthropic signed up to $517B in compute contracts over eleven months (own data centers, 14.8GW) while GPT-6 Astra quietly beat Portal start-to-finish in ~24 hours with no human help. China dominates the rest: Moonshot AI confidentially filed for a ~$50B Hong Kong IPO (Q1 2027 target), Alibaba open-sourced Qwen-Drive 1.0 for end-to-end driving, and OpenBMB shipped MiniCPM5-2B, the strongest open model at ≤4B params. Policy: NYC banned AI tools in public schools through eighth grade. Hugging Face's NVIDIA union keeps consolidating — CTO julien_c reports ~99% positive reactions from rivals and allies alike — and Hermes Agent now lets every bot serve its own OpenAI-compatible API endpoint with an independent key.

articles.title: Anthropic signed up to $517B in compute contracts over 11 months — own data centers planned
articles.summary: Anthropic locked in up to $517B of compute (14.8GW, own data centers) after Dario warned of reckless spend — still trailing OpenAI's $750B plan.

articles.title: GPT-6 Astra beat Portal start to finish in ~24 hours with zero human help
articles.summary: Astra solved the puzzle game Portal solo in about a day after the initial goal — dev cozyblaze open-sourced the run: 'the worst model we'll ever get.'

articles.title: AI-designed drug rentosertib appears to turn back the body's biological clock
articles.summary: Nature Biotech study: Insilico's AI-designed rentosertib made six aging clocks predict patients biologically up to six years younger than placebo.

articles.title: New York City bans AI tools from public schools through eighth grade
articles.summary: NYC bars AI use in public schools through the end of middle school — the biggest US district yet to pull AI tools from early classrooms.

articles.title: Alibaba releases Qwen-Drive 1.0 — perception, traffic Q&A and route planning in one model
articles.summary: Open-source driving model (Apache-2.0) shows text-image models don't get 3D space for free — spatial awareness had to be trained in explicitly.

articles.title: ChatGPT claws web traffic share back to 55.5% as Gemini's brief comeback fades
articles.summary: Similarweb: ChatGPT regained 55.5% of AI chatbot web traffic — but YoY lead shrank from 73.3% as Gemini doubled and Claude grew nearly 5x.

articles.title: Moonshot AI confidentially files for Hong Kong IPO — ~$3B raise at ~$50B valuation
articles.summary: Goldman Sachs, CICC, Deutsche Bank lined up; listing as early as Q1 2027 after Kimi K3 demand suspended consumer subs at ~$300M ARR.

articles.title: Hermes Agent: every bot is now its own OpenAI-compatible API server
articles.summary: Each Hermes bot can hold its own API key and serve its own endpoint — isolated per-bot access instead of routing everything through one gateway.

articles.title: Hugging Face CTO: ~99% of reactions to the NVIDIA union have been positive
articles.summary: julien_c cites endorsements from Nadella, Pichai, Musk, Murati and rivals — 'a chance to make open-source AI so much bigger' after the Sep 3 tie-up.

articles.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp is 'amazing at creating game worlds' — community build
articles.summary: Weekend demo: the vision model generated a full playable game in about two days of QA — a showcase of image-to-interactive-code range.

articles.title: OpenBMB's MiniCPM5-2B tops the intelligence index for open models at 4B params or below
articles.summary: MiniCPM5-2B scores 15 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.2 — highest of any open-weights model at 4B or under (HF: openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B).
